_national.labelling: District PDOs grouped in three wine regions: Podravje (Stajerska Slovenija, Prekmurje), Posavje (Bizeljsko Sremic, Dolenjska, Bela krajina) and Primorska (Goriska Brda, Vipavska dolina, Kras, Slovenska Istra). Quality levels: kakovostno vino ZGP (quality wine with protected geographical origin) and vrhunsko vino ZGP (premium); special-quality sweet wines pozna trgatev (late harvest), izbor, jagodni izbor, suhi jagodni izbor and ledeno vino (ice wine). PTP wines (vino s priznanim tradicionalnim poimenovanjem: Cvicek, Teran, Metliska crnina, Belokranjec, Bizeljcan) are traditional styles with their own PDOs. Sparkling: penina.

si-belokranjec.min_alcohol: Actual 10.5 to 11.5%; average natural alcohol at least 9.0%.
si-belokranjec.styles: White PTP blend from Bela krajina; at least 16.3 points at tasting.

si-cvicek.varieties: Blend: 40 to 50% Zametovka (exceptionally 60%), 10 to 15% Kraljevina, 15 to 20% Modra frankinja (exceptionally 30%), up to 10% Laski rizling, up to 15% other; at least 65% red and 25% white varieties.
si-cvicek.min_alcohol: Actual 8.5 to 10.0% (natural at least 8%); sugar max 2.5 g/l.
si-cvicek.styles: Light, dry, pale ruby PTP wine from Dolenjska; red grapes macerated max four days at no more than 22 C; no stopped fermentation.

si-metliska-crnina.min_alcohol: Actual 10.3 to 11.5%; average natural alcohol at least 9.0%.
si-metliska-crnina.styles: Red PTP blend from Bela krajina; must score at least 16.5 points at tasting; not sold before 30 November of the vintage.

src.title: eAmbrosia technical file: PDO Metliska crnina (2011)

si-teran.min_alcohol: Actual 10.0 to 13.0% (enriched Teran 10.0 to 11.0%); natural at least 9.2% (10.8% for "izbrani teran", never enriched). Enrichment max 2.0% only with Karst Refosk concentrate or sucrose (max 3.5 kg/100 l).
si-teran.styles: Dry, still red PTP wine from the Karst plateau sub-district (Kraska planota) of Kras: deep ruby, high acidity (6 to 11 g/l) and polyphenols (at least 900 mg/l), malolactic required; no warm maceration, chemical acidification or hot bottling.
si-teran.labelling: The name "Teran" for Slovenian wine is reserved for this PDO.
